tactical_notes: Nykopings BIS (4-3-3) aims to control midfield through Enis Ahmetovic with wide wingers stretching Smedby's fullbacks. However, they are vulnerable to counter-attacks. Smedby AIS (4-4-2/4-3-3) plays aggressive direct football with Joel Unger pressing high to force backline turnovers. Smedby's high tempo (0.40) favors an open, transition-based match.
